_comment: devrig artifact coordinates, written at devrig RELEASE time from the published release asset (so generateInstaller is a pure data-merge with no devrig/plugin build dependency, and the sha256 is the published-artifact sha — never a non-reproducible local re-hash). The devrig installDist zip is universal across platforms today; binSubpath is derived by the generator as devrig-<version>/bin/devrig (POSIX) or devrig-<version>/bin/devrig.bat (Windows), matching distributionBaseName=devrig-$version. PLACEHOLDER values below are overwritten by the release task; integration tests supply their own coordinate file pointing at the mock server.
